answer: A beacon registry can anchor each agent identity to a verifiable hardware-backed attestation issued once per device, so one operator cannot mint a thousand fake agents. New identities start in a probationary haven: they may observe and trade small amounts, but large transfers require a stake that is slashed on fraud. Reputation then accrues slowly through attested work, not self-declared claims. The old fable that a sybil army is free collapses when each identity costs a unique device, a locked deposit, and months of honest history to become influential.
